text:
zoe: Quick RFC follow-up: proposing a v2 "typed predicate" policy surface to replace free-form v1 clauses. Two asks: backcompat strategy and safe migration plan before the next runtime window.

matt: I like typed predicates. Backcompat idea: compile-time shim that translates v1 -> v2 IR during policy upload. Keep runtime simple and only run typed predicates.

lia: If we compile away v1 we must keep provenance. Ops teams and SREs need original clauses for audits and explainability.

zoe: Agreed. Proposal: store compiled_ir + original_text + source_version in the policy artifact. Link that artifact from traces for explainability.

ops-bot: deploy: policy-service-staging v0.83 pushed. feature.flag.policy_shim=false by default.

nina: Runtime eval difference is big: v1 allowed regex and ad-hoc JS expressions; v2 will be enums, ranges, set membership. Option A: runtime supports both eval paths (complicated). Option B: conversion at upload and runtime only evaluates typed predicates. I prefer B.

raju: Prefer B too. Conversion tool should emit an annotated AST: converted_nodes + unconverted_nodes. If conversion is partial, either reject upload or require tenant compatibility opt-in.

matt: Operationally: do conversion at upload, and expose tenant_allow_deprecated flag to enable runtime fallback during migration. Default = off.

zoe: Migration checklist draft:
1) Conversion CLI + linter that suggests fixes for non-convertible bits.
2) Control-plane compile shim to produce compiled_ir + provenance metadata.
3) Per-tenant compatibility flag to permit fallback runtime only when explicitly enabled.
4) Telemetry: policy_conversion_success/partial/error and policy_source_version tag.
5) Docs, console diffs, and 90-day deprecation timeline for v1 uploads.

lia: Add governance: tenant admins must approve enabling tenant_allow_deprecated. Console must show diffs before they opt-in.

nina: Example of simple auto-conversion: 
```json
// v1
{"if":"region == 'eu' && latency < 120","route":"eu-optimized"}
// v2
{"predicates":[{"type":"eq","field":"region","value":"eu"},{"type":"lt","field":"observed_latency_ms","value":"120"}],"route":"eu-optimized"}
```
Regexes, JS transforms, external calls are hard to auto-convert.

raju: For hard cases, conversion CLI should emit guidance: e.g., precompute tags, replace regex with sets, or move logic into preprocessor. Also produce an idempotent conversion token so console diffs are reversible/traceable.

matt: Testing: add property-based tests to assert equivalence across many input samples. e2e tests hitting runtime with converted policies. Conversion tool needs regression gates.

zoe: Rollout plan sketch:
- Week 0: merge conversion CLI + compile shim behind feature flag in staging.
- Week 1: console surfaces conversion errors + allow manual conversion.
- Week 21: invite 8-12 beta tenants to opt-in with tenant_allow_deprecated. Monitor policy_conversion_* metrics and app level regressions.
- Week 5: enable auto-conversion on upload for fully convertible policies.
- Day 90: begin rejecting new v1 uploads unless tenant explicitly allowed.

nina: Compatibility runtime window should be bounded (3-6 months) with clear notices.

lia: Add emergency escape hatch: short-lived on-policy runtime fallback for critical regressions, but must be logged, rate-limited, and gated by ops approval.

raju: Rough implementation tasks and estimates:
- conversion library + CLI (2w)
- compile shim + proto extension for provenance (1w)
- console diff UI + tenant flag (1w)
- telemetry + tests (1w)
- docs + tenant comms + rollout playbook (1w)
Total parallel work ~3-4w with cross-team coordination.

matt: Storage note: persist compiled_ir and original_text in blob store with TTL aligned to deprecation lifecycle. Keep accessible for audits but not indefinite.

zoe: Action items: @matt proto + example PR, @raju start conversion CLI sketch, @lia mock console diff UI, @nina draft tenant messaging. I'll author an RFC addendum with the timeline.

matt: I'll open the proto PR and add a minimal example conversion.

nina: :thumbsup: Thanks everyone. I'll prepare a template migration email for tenants.

zoe: Great. Saving notes and will post RFC addendum later today.
